QuestInfo.name: A Member of The Maple Alliance
QuestInfo.0: You stood before Empress Cygnus of Ereve. In spite of her delicate appearance, you could feel her inner strength and power.
QuestInfo.1: Empress Cygnus has asked you to join the Maple Alliance and fight evil together.
QuestInfo.2: You've happily accepted Empress Cygnus' invitation to be part of the Maple Alliance.
